Negotiation and fallback order that chooses mergeable large or small receive modes.

findings.text: Exposes ring capacity query that selects packed or split backing based on current layout discriminant, allowing callers to size pools and refill thresholds without knowing layout internals.
Exposes DMA device lookup that returns a device only when mapping API is active and no custom mapping operation overrides it, otherwise signalling allocation-only operation.
Exposes driver-side re-enable for configuration change notifications that clears the driver-disabled state and delivers one deferred notification if a change arrived while disabled.
Receive completion entry that records an arrival counter for its queue and schedules associated NAPI context for polling.

Receive NAPI poll entry that disables callbacks, reclaims transmit completions, ingests receive completions up to budget, handles redirection flush and transmit kick for XDP outcomes, and completes polling with conditional moderation update when intake is below budget.

Transmit NAPI poll entry that reclaims completed transmissions or XSK transmissions under queue lock, wakes stopped queue when free space suffices, and completes with a re-poll check for completions arriving during completion.

Device open entry that pre-fills active receive queues, enables each queue pair, establishes carrier state with or without link-status feature, enables configuration notifications, and unwinds enabled pairs with moderation cancellation on failure.

Refill dispatcher prefers XSK path when present, otherwise selects mergeable or big or small allocation per device mode in a loop until descriptors exhaust, then conditionally notifies device and accounts kick statistics, reporting memory exhaustion distinctly from other outcomes.

Small receive path sizes buffer from header length plus padding plus maximum packet plus headroom with alignment for data and shared info, allocates from page pool, offsets past pad and headroom, encodes capacity in opaque context for completion, and returns page on submission failure.

Large packet path builds a scatter table spanning multiple pages with header isolated in first entry and payload in second entry sharing one page, chains pages through private linkage matching table order, and releases the whole chain on allocation or submission failure.

Mergeable sizing reuses remaining room when supplied, otherwise clamps length estimator between configured minimum and page minus header and aligns for cache, reserving front headroom and conditional tail room for XDP assumptions while disabling coalescing expectations.

Receive intake bounds work by budget with distinct XSK versus page-pool versus direct retrieval, aggregates per-batch statistics into queue counters under sequence protection, triggers refill when free descriptors exceed half of budget or ring size, and forces rescheduling by claiming full budget when refill fails for lack of memory.

NAPI enable path enables polling then immediately schedules once under bottom-half protection to cover completions arriving before enable, binds queue to NAPI context, while transmit enable additionally requires non-zero weight and affinity hint and otherwise disables polling.

Queue pair activation registers XDP receive context, selects page-pool versus shared memory model from pool presence, then enables receive and transmit polling, with failure unwinding registration and deactivation unregistering after polling is stopped.

Page pool creation is skipped for large non-mergeable mode, otherwise provisions one pool per pair sized from ring capacity and NUMA locality with NAPI binding, enabling DMA mapping with device synchronisation when backend offers DMA device and falling back to allocation-only otherwise, destroying created pools on failure and all pools on teardown.

Transmit preparation validates tunnel header negotiation and builds header from socket buffer, clears buffer count for mergeable mode, chooses inline push when alignment and headroom and clone state allow versus separate header entry, converts payload to scatter entries, and forwards orphan status to output accounting.

Tunnel header conversion delegates non-tunnel payloads to basic conversion with optional length fixup, rejects tunnel payloads when tunnel negotiation is absent, zeroes hash reporting fields, temporarily masks tunnel segmentation types during basic parsing before restoring them, and derives tunnel type and checksum flag plus offset fields from packet headers.
Header length helper derives length from transport offset plus upper-layer header length with distinct handling for datagram versus stream protocols and converts result to device endianness.
Link settings refresh is gated on speed duplex feature, reads speed and duplex from device configuration through endian-aware access, and adopts each value only after validation.

Receive moderation sampling is skipped when no packets arrived in current poll, otherwise folds call and packet and byte counters into a sample and resets poll count, while cancellation is gated on notification coalescing feature.

Configuration state is guarded by interrupt-safe spin protection with pending flag coalescing, transmit reclamation holds queue lock with try versus full acquisition per context, receive and kick counters use sequence-protected updates with interrupt-safe variant in refill path, and NAPI scheduling after enable is wrapped in bottom-half suspension while moderation update after completion intentionally omits its lock.

Receive queue groups a virtqueue with its NAPI context and page pool, plus statistics with synchroniser, moderation state with enable flag, XSK pool selector, packet length estimator with minimum, and arrival and in-poll counters, with scatter table used only in large mode.

Send queue groups a virtqueue with its NAPI context and statistics, plus reset indicator, XSK selector, and scatter table sized from fragment count, bound to a transmit queue of the network device by shared index.
Device configuration state groups core-enabled and driver-disabled booleans with a pending-change flag and a lock, linked to driver callbacks through conversion from generic driver to virtio driver.

Configuration notification moves between enabled and driver-disabled with deferred delivery: changes arriving while core is off or driver is disabled set pending without invoking callback, and re-enable clears disabled and delivers at most one pending callback.

Polling moves from callback-disabled intake to conditional completion: receive below budget attempts completion and on success updates moderation, transmit completion checks for new arrivals and reschedules if needed, and refill exhaustion forces continued polling by reporting full budget.

Receive allocation failures must distinguish memory exhaustion from other errors, release pages or chained pages or pools on the failing path, avoid leaking opaque contexts, and preserve rescheduling so temporary exhaustion is retried in next poll rather than stalling the queue.

Completions arriving between queue fill and NAPI enable would be lost without immediate scheduling, transmit callback re-arming must loop until stable before waking queue, and queue wake must only occur after sufficient free space is observed under lock to avoid premature transmission.

Feature and status selectors govern optional behavior: speed duplex availability, link status with link-up indication, guest header length, queue notification coalescing, tunnel header negotiation, mergeable versus large versus small modes, memory model choice, queue direction types, XDP transmit versus redirect disposition, and packed versus ordered layout discrimination.
Configuration read helper is sleepable and type-checked, dispatching narrow widths to single get operation and wider widths to repeated read before converting from little endian to host order.
Packed determination treats both unordered and in-order packed layouts as packed, and ring size query selects corresponding backing size accordingly.

Receive-poll transmit cleanup is skipped for weightless or raw-buffer queues and for reset state, otherwise disables callbacks and reclaims completions under try-lock with delayed re-enable loop before conditional queue wake.
